consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, so the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all NodePool objects) and update status.storedVersions on the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration (re-write all NodePool objects so they are stored as v1) and update status.storedVersions on the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD before upgrading to a later release that removes v1beta1.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD changes from v1beta1 to v1, so existing NodePool objects remain stored as v1beta1 until a storage version migration (re-writing all objects and updating status.storedVersions) is run, which must happen before a later release removes v1beta1.
